production_before_correction.failed_case: wide transparent artwork after repeated rotations

cause: Artwork data-ready and the preparation download depended only on effect-driven busy state. A new project render could briefly retain the previous result's ready state before the effect marked it busy.
correction: Compare the emitted result's project signature, step, port and quality against the current request synchronously during rendering. Stale results stay labelled updating and cannot expose a current preparation download.

assertions: saved quarter-turn value after every click
actual output dimensions after every turn
identical full-resolution image bytes after four turns
